title: Create a Color Array from a Palette
text: Quickly create a Color Array from a Library Palette via the options in the Color Window.

title: Quickly add backgrounds
text: Add a background to any Shape by right clicking on it in the Viewport. You can then round corners and change the colour of the Rectangle that this creates.

title: Drag to close open contours
text: Drag and drop end points to interactively close contours in the Viewport.

title: Alt/option drag attributes
text: Scrubbing attributes with the alt/option key held will update both values at the same time.

title: Precisely distribute Gradient Stops with ease
text: Quickly distribute gradient stops to create smooth color transitions along gradients.

title: Jump to the next keyframe
text: Use hot keys to move the playhead to the next or previous keyframe.

title: Remove bezier handles
text: Hold the X key to remove bezier handles in the Graph Editor.

title: Hold S to add new points to Paths
text: Hold S when in the Edit Shape tool to create new points along edges.
